name: Change requests and plan versioning
userOutcome: The user can review newly discovered work or scope changes, understand impact, decide, and preserve plan history.
productionDataSource: Active plan, affected tasks, discovery facts, proposed graph patch, estimates, approvals, and events.
errorBehavior: Roll back a failed graph transaction, preserve the original plan, identify affected work, and allow correction without losing the request.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not silently add work to an approved plan.
Do not misclassify defects as scope changes.
